I have farmed this rented plot for some years now, and because it is not my own land, I do not put heavy investments like manure or expensive fertilizer into it. I will plant the cowpea seeds I kept from last season and manage the weeding with my family, since buying chemicals or improved seeds costs money I do not have right now. Over the season, my children and I will put in about ninety days of work, and I may hire about ten days of extra hands when it is time to harvest so the pods do not spoil in the field.
